ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

protocol_overview.type: Command-response over a shared CMD line + block-oriented data transfer over DAT line(s). Host-mastered, host-clocked synchronous serial.
protocol_overview.duplex: half-duplex (CMD is bidirectional but not simultaneously; DAT direction depends on read vs write)
wire_names_sd_mode: CMD (host ↔ card, bidirectional, push-pull / open-drain in identification)
protocol_overview.host_role: Bus master; drives CLK, initiates every transaction with a 48-bit command on CMD, supplies data on DAT for writes, and consumes data on DAT for reads.
protocol_overview.card_role: Bus slave; responds on CMD to host commands, drives DAT during read; sinks DAT during write; signals busy by holding DAT0 LOW during programming.

functional_requirements.text: The SD bus shall use a 9-pin physical interface: 1 CLK, 1 CMD, 4 DAT (DAT0..DAT3), 1 VDD, 2 VSS (VSS1, VSS2).
Three bus modes shall be supported: SD 1-bit mode (CLK + CMD + DAT0), SD 4-bit mode (CLK + CMD + DAT0..DAT3, default for SD), and SPI mode (CLK + CS + DI + DO).
Every command on CMD shall be 48 bits: 1 start bit (0) + 1 transmission bit (1=host, 0=card) + 6-bit command index + 32-bit argument + 7-bit CRC7 + 1 end bit (1).
Response classes shall be R1 (48-bit normal), R1b (R1 with optional busy), R2 (136-bit CID/CSD), R3 (48-bit OCR), R6 (48-bit published RCA), R7 (48-bit interface condition).
Data shall be transferred as blocks (default 512 bytes) framed by a Start Bit (LOW) and an End Bit (HIGH), with a 16-bit CRC-CCITT per active DAT line appended before the End Bit.
All CMD line traffic (host commands and card responses except R3) shall be protected by CRC7 with polynomial x^7 + x^3 + 1.
All DAT line block traffic shall be protected by CRC16 with polynomial x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1 (CRC-CCITT) per active DAT line.

The card shall implement a 10-state machine: Inactive, Idle, Ready, Identification (Ident), Stand-by (Stby), Transfer (Tran), Sending-data (Data), Receive-data (Rcv), Programming (Prg), Disconnect (Dis).

Initialization shall be: CMD0 (GO_IDLE_STATE) → CMD8 (SEND_IF_COND, v2.0+) → ACMD41 (SD_SEND_OP_COND, looped until card ready) → CMD2 (ALL_SEND_CID) → CMD3 (SEND_RELATIVE_ADDR) → CMD9 (SEND_CSD) → CMD7 (SELECT_CARD) → CMD16 (SET_BLOCKLEN) → data transfer.
The card shall operate at VDD = 2.7-3.6 V (high voltage range). UHS-I and 1.8 V signaling are enabled via Voltage Switch Command (CMD11) after CMD8 reports S18A/S18R agreement.
During programming or busy responses, the card shall hold DAT0 LOW to signal busy to the host; release of DAT0 to HIGH terminates the busy state.
Bus width shall be selected by ACMD6 (SET_BUS_WIDTH); legal values are 1 (DAT0 only) or 4 (DAT0..DAT3).
Application-specific commands (ACMD*) shall be preceded by CMD55 (APP_CMD) in the same active state; without the CMD55 prefix the same index decodes as a normal CMD.
The card shall tolerate hot insertion / hot removal with proper power-up / power-down ramp (VDD ramp + 74-clock dummy cycles before CMD0).
UHS-I above SDR50 (i.e. SDR104, and optionally DDR50) shall require a Tuning sequence (CMD19, SEND_TUNING_BLOCK) for sampling-point calibration.

configurations.name: SD 1-bit mode
configurations.description: Legacy / minimum-pin operation. CLK + CMD + DAT0 only. Used in card identification and on low-pin-count hosts.

configurations.name: SD 4-bit mode
configurations.description: Default high-performance SD mode. CLK + CMD + DAT0..DAT3; selected via ACMD6 (SET_BUS_WIDTH = 4).

configurations.name: SPI mode
configurations.description: Optional compatibility mode for microcontrollers. CLK + CS + DI + DO; subset of commands; CRC optional (enabled by CMD59).

error_response_conditions: CMD CRC7 mismatch — card ignores the command; host detects via absent response and may retry.
DAT CRC16 mismatch on write — card returns a 'CRC error' Data Response Token and does not program the block.
DAT CRC16 mismatch on read — host detects locally and may retry by re-issuing the read command.
Illegal command in current state — card sets ILLEGAL_COMMAND bit in Card Status (CSR) returned in the next R1.
Out-of-range address — card sets OUT_OF_RANGE bit in CSR; programming is not performed.
Card write-protected — card sets WP_VIOLATION bit; write is not performed.
Erase parameter error — card sets ERASE_PARAM bit and does not perform the erase.
Timeout on busy (R1b / write programming) — card may signal CC_ERROR / CARD_ECC_FAILED in CSR.
compliance_requirements: Host shall issue 74 dummy CLK cycles after VDD reaches operating range before driving CMD0.
Host shall use open-drain mode on CMD until ACMD41 reports the card busy bit clear, then switch to push-pull.
Host shall sample CMD/DAT outputs from the card on the rising edge of CLK (Default Speed) or per the High Speed / UHS-I timing tables.
Card shall complete initialization within 1 second of receiving a valid ACMD41 with the host-supported voltage window.
Card shall hold DAT0 LOW during programming or busy until ready; host shall not issue dependent commands while DAT0 is LOW (except CMD13 SEND_STATUS).
Voltage switching (CMD11) shall only be initiated after CMD8 and ACMD41 with S18A=1 in the OCR response; signal voltage transition shall follow the UHS-I Voltage Switch Sequence (Section 4.2.4).
